tools.name: twicecommerce_get_merchant
tools.description: Get the merchant account: name, country, currency, timezone, languages, plan and enabled features. Good first call. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/merchant.

tools.name: twicecommerce_list_service_locations
tools.description: List pickup and return locations (service locations). Use the ids to filter orders and stock items. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/service-locations/.

tools.name: twicecommerce_list_taxes
tools.description: List the tax rates set up for the merchant. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/taxes/.

tools.name: twicecommerce_list_tags
tools.description: List tags used on inventory, catalog, customers or orders. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/tags.

tools.name: twicecommerce_list_orders
tools.description: List orders with status, customers, line items, totals and dates. The API does not paginate this list, so the result is cut to `limit` rows (newest as returned by the API); the full count is in totalCount. Narrow it with location_ids. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/orders.

tools.name: twicecommerce_get_order
tools.description: Get one order by id: status, customers, line items, stock items, comments, totals and pricing. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/orders/{orderId}.

tools.name: twicecommerce_get_order_payments
tools.description: List the payment transactions of one order (needs a key with the Payments area). Admin API: GET /v1/admin/orders/{orderId}/payments.

tools.name: twicecommerce_get_order_invoices
tools.description: List the invoices of one order, optionally with the upcoming scheduled subscription invoices (needs a key with the Payments area). Admin API: GET /v1/admin/orders/{orderId}/invoices.

tools.name: twicecommerce_list_customers
tools.description: List customers, with an optional text search over name and email and paging. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/customers.

tools.name: twicecommerce_get_customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id: contact details, addresses and type. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/customers/{customerId}.

tools.name: twicecommerce_get_customer_orders
tools.description: List the orders of one customer. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/customers/{customerId}/orders.

tools.name: twicecommerce_list_catalog_items
tools.description: List catalog items (the listings customers rent, buy or subscribe to), with an optional name search and paging. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/catalog/.

tools.name: twicecommerce_get_catalog_item
tools.description: Get one catalog item by id: name, status, variants, rules and pricing links. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/catalog/{id}.

tools.name: twicecommerce_check_availability
tools.description: Check whether one catalog item can be booked for a date-time window (before you create an order). Dates are ISO 8601 date-times in UTC, for example 2026-11-05T09:00:00Z. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/availability/{catalogItemId}/period.

tools.name: twicecommerce_list_discount_codes
tools.description: List discount codes with usage and validity, with paging. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/discount-codes.

tools.name: twicecommerce_list_stock_items
tools.description: List stock items (the physical units, called articles in the API), with paging. Narrow by location ids. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/articles/.

tools.name: twicecommerce_get_stock_item
tools.description: Get one stock item by id: SKU, condition, quantity, location and status. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/articles/{id}.

tools.name: twicecommerce_list_skus
tools.description: List SKUs (the product definitions that stock items belong to), with paging. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/skus.

tools.name: twicecommerce_get_sku
tools.description: Get one SKU by id. Admin API: GET /v1/admin/skus/{skuId}.

tools.name: twicecommerce_add_order_comment
tools.description: WRITE: add a comment to an order (needs a key with Write access to Order details). Each call adds a new comment; do not repeat a call that succeeded. Admin API: POST /v1/admin/orders/{orderId}/comments.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: twicecommerce_get_order, twicecommerce_list_customers · Private data: twicecommerce_get_customer · Public sink: twicecommerce_list_customers, twicecommerce_add_order_comment.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: twicecommerce_get_order, twicecommerce_list_customers · Private data: twicecommerce_get_customer · Public sink: twicecommerce_list_customers, twicecommerce_add_order_comment

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
